query: I forgot my password and need to sign in.
answer: Select Forgot password on the sign-in page and follow the reset link sent to your registered email address. For security, only the most recently issued link will work. Category: authentication [Source FAQ-0011]
retrieved_context:
[FAQ-0011] I forgot my password. How do I reset it?
Select Forgot password on the sign-in page and follow the reset link sent to your registered email address.

[FAQ-0012] My password reset link has expired. What should I do?
Request a new reset link from the sign-in page. For security, only the most recently issued link will work.

[FAQ-0017] I received a login alert that I do not recognize.
Change your password immediately, sign out all devices, enable two-factor authentication, and contact support if account details were changed.

[FAQ-0081] How long do I have to return an item?
Most unused items can be returned within 30 days of delivery. Final-sale and personalized products are excluded.

[FAQ-0086] Can I return a personalized item?
Personalized items are not returnable for preference changes, but support will help if the item is defective or made incorrectly.

[FAQ-0040] Can you resend my purchase receipt?
Open the order in Order history and select Resend receipt. Guest customers can use the link in their order-confirmation email.

query: When should an approved refund appear on my card?
answer: Allow five business days plus your bank's posting time. Then contact support with the refund confirmation and order number.
retrieved_context:
[FAQ-0094] My approved refund has not appeared.
Allow five business days plus your bank's posting time. Then contact support with the refund confirmation and order number.

[FAQ-0099] Will I receive confirmation when a refund is issued?
Yes. A refund confirmation is emailed when the payment provider receives the refund instruction.

[FAQ-0091] How long does a refund take?
After the return is approved, refunds are sent to the original payment method within five business days; banks may take longer to post them.

query: Could I transfer my reward points to my sister?
answer: No. Points cannot be transferred, sold, or combined between customer accounts.
retrieved_context:
[FAQ-0169] Can reward points be exchanged for cash?
No. Points have no cash value and can only be redeemed through eligible Northstar Shop transactions.

[FAQ-0168] Can I transfer points to another account?
Reward points cannot be transferred, sold, or combined between customer accounts.

[FAQ-0164] How can I use reward points?
At checkout, choose an available reward amount before payment. Points cannot reduce the order below the minimum displayed.

query: Someone claiming to be support asked for my password.
retrieved_context:
[FAQ-0155] Will support ever ask for my password?
No. Support will never request your password, complete card number, or two-factor authentication code.

[FAQ-0200] Why is support asking me to verify my identity?
Verification protects account and order information. Support will use approved checks but will never ask for your password or security code.

[FAQ-0153] I think someone accessed my account.
Reset the password, sign out all devices, enable two-factor authentication, review account details, and contact support immediately.

query: My promotional code is not accepted at checkout.

[FAQ-0182] Why is my promotional code invalid?
Check its spelling, dates, eligible products, regional restrictions, minimum spend, and whether it has already been used.

[FAQ-0181] Where do I enter a promotional code?
Enter the code in the Promotion field at checkout and select Apply before submitting payment.

[FAQ-0183] Can I combine two promotional codes?
Only one promotional code can be used per order unless the offer terms explicitly permit stacking.
